term: ladder of routes on one signature
definition: Five route tables on the two beings of the capacity model, all with Signature: noMaximum (no maximum, structural premises and q.14 a.1 kept), compositeRoot (composite matter-form maximum, uniting premise dropped), simpleImpersonal (immaterial maximum, q.14 a.1 dropped), willless (intellect, q.19 a.1 dropped), classicalRoute (all kept). Rows are analyst-built and show satisfiability of the bundle only.
note: Analyst-built models. Names are comparison labels. No model is shown metaphysically possible, and noMaximum's row making the root a component of a prior being is a device to keep q.14 a.1, not a proposal. See docs/notes/physical-ground-468.md.
